# Casa La Playa Puerto Vallarta

> Casa La Playa is a fully staffed, privately owned 8-bedroom beachfront vacation rental villa on Playa Camarones in downtown Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco, Mexico. It is rented to one group at a time and booked directly at casalaplaya.com.

Key facts (current as of 2026):

- Location: Calle Paraguay 1201, Colonia 5 de Diciembre, 48350 Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco, Mexico. Beachfront on Playa Camarones, north edge of downtown. Not in Conchas Chinas, the Hotel Zone or Marina Vallarta.
- What sets it apart: beachfront and within walking distance of downtown restaurants, bars, nightclubs, art galleries, shopping and the Malecón, so guests don't need a car or taxis; only one group at a time for full privacy.
- Distances: about a 10-minute walk (0.8 km) to the Malecón; 15–20 minutes by car to Puerto Vallarta International Airport (PVR).
- Size: 20,000 sq ft, 3 stories with elevator, 175 ft of beachfront.
- Bedrooms: 8 oceanfront suites. Rentable as 6 bedrooms (up to 12 guests), 7 bedrooms (up to 14 guests) or the full 8-bedroom house (up to 16 guests).
- Beds: mostly king beds, including 2 kings in the penthouse; 2 ground-floor rooms convert from a king to 2 twin beds for guests sharing a room.
- Bathrooms: 8 full and 2 half.
- Pools: 2 pools and a jacuzzi.
- Staff included: private chef (breakfast and lunch), two maids, night watchman, bilingual house manager and concierge (Paz) with an office across the street; bartender on request. A staff member is on site throughout each stay.
- Food and drinks: breakfast and lunch chef service included; dinner chef service extra. Groceries are paid separately in cash (credit cards are not accepted at this time), estimated at $20–$60 per person per day. Recommended staff tip: 10–15% or more of the pre-tax rental rate. Most staff have worked for the owner's family for many years.
- Ownership: family-owned for more than 25 years; staff are hired locally and food and services are sourced from local businesses as much as possible.
- Larger groups: the house sleeps up to 16. Day guests can visit for a day fee that compensates the staff; the team can help find nearby hotels or a second home close by for extra guests.
- House rules: very few. Guests are asked to have fun, be smart and respect the community.
- Extras arranged by the house manager: in-house massages and spa services, scuba diving with pool refresher, house-call doctor.
- Meals: breakfast and lunch chef service included; dinner available for a fee; guests reimburse grocery costs with receipts.
- Nightly rates (USD): 6 bedrooms $3,200; 7 bedrooms $4,000; 8 bedrooms $5,000; Christmas week $7,000; Easter week $5,500 (8 bedrooms only). Plus 19% hotel and local taxes. Christmas and New Year's require the full house and a one-week minimum.
- Not affiliated with La Casa de la Playa (Xcaret, Riviera Maya) or Casa La Playa at Cuixmala.
- Booking: book direct by phone +1 310-986-2299 or email info@casalaplaya.com, with no booking-site service fees; airport pickup is included for direct bookings.
